def pearson(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    mx = sum(x) / n
    my = sum(y) / n
    num_ = sum((x[i] - mx) * (y[i] - my) for i in range(n))
    dx = sum((x[i] - mx) ** 2 for i in range(n))
